summary_1line: At Yudhishthira’s sacrifice, Sahadeva defends Krishna’s first worship, angering Sisupala and other kings who begin plotting to disrupt the ceremony.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sahadeva defiantly places his foot forward before the assembled kings, challenging any who oppose the worship of Krishna.
A shower of flowers falls upon Sahadeva as a heavenly voice praises him while sages and kings look on.
Sisupala, eyes red with anger, rallies hostile kings in the crowded sacrificial hall as Krishna calmly watches.
